meta.source: Glumira-7.2 Vaults/4-Governance/Rows/4.8-Design-System (DECISIONS.md, LEDGER.md); colour values from the glumira-color-method skill and docs/04_Brand.

tokens.name: navy-950
tokens.usage: Navy ramp, deepest step: the ink every shadow is mixed from (D-08). Never a surface.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Navy ramp. Row 1 and row 2 header bars, both themes.

tokens.name: navy-850
tokens.usage: Navy ramp. Hover on a navy button: one step toward its shadow.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Base navy #102347, locked. Dark ground; light-theme ink.

tokens.name: navy-750
tokens.usage: Navy + 6% bone. Raised surface: cards, buttons, panes.

tokens.name: navy-725
tokens.usage: Navy + 9% bone. Lit corner and lit edge of a raised surface (D-08, D-09).

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Navy + 12% bone. Pane lines and menus in the dark theme.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Navy + 20% bone. The line of a field you type in, dark theme.

tokens.name: navy-550
tokens.usage: Navy + 30% bone. Muted text in the light theme (5.7:1 on bone, 6.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: navy-500
tokens.usage: Navy + 36% bone, the step of his 'navy +35% white'. Headings in the light theme (4.7:1 on bone).

tokens.name: navy-450
tokens.usage: Navy + 50% bone. The line of a field you type in, light theme (3.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: navy-300
tokens.usage: Navy + 67% bone. Headings and muted text in the dark theme (7.1:1 on navy, 6.0:1 on raised).

tokens.name: navy-150
tokens.usage: Navy + 85% bone. Reserved step of the ramp.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Bone, locked. Light ground; ink in the dark theme (14.3:1 on navy).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Bone hairline from the swatch board. Lines in the light theme.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised surface in the light theme only.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one gold text (his 'USE THIS'). Only on navy: the GluMira word, the active tab mark, card ids (D-11). 6.5:1 on navy; never on bone.

tokens.name: gold-band-top
tokens.usage: Top of the bottom band of the gold gradient ('We only use the bottom part of the gradient'). The lit end of the gold button.

tokens.name: gold-band-mid
tokens.usage: Middle of the bottom band. The lit end of a hovered gold button.

tokens.name: gold-band-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the bottom band. The shadow end of the gold button.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status dot: running, done. Existing Builder value. Always with a word beside it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status dot: waiting. Existing Builder value. Always with a word beside it.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Status dot: failed. Swatch-board red. Always with a word beside it; never as text on navy.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Row 1 and row 2. Navy in BOTH themes, so the gold word always sits on navy (D-11).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and pane ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, standard buttons, the toast, an open card.

tokens.name: raised-lit
tokens.usage: The lit corner (top right) of a raised surface, and its 1px lit edge.

tokens.name: raised-hover
tokens.usage: A raised button on hover: one step toward its own shadow.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and the select list.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Pane lines, row dividers, the standard button edge. 1px only.

tokens.name: line-input
tokens.usage: The edge of a field you type in.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on ground and raised (dark 14.3:1 and 12.2:1; light 14.3:1 and 15.5:1).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings and sub-headings, weight 600: the third colour, navy lifted with bone (D-10). Dark 7.1:1 on navy; light 4.7:1 on bone.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta text, quiet buttons, the eyebrow, placeholders. Dark 6.0:1 on raised; light 5.7:1 on bone.

tokens.name: on-header
tokens.usage: Tab labels and icons on the navy header, both themes (16.8:1).

tokens.name: on-header-muted
tokens.usage: Unselected tabs and meta on the navy header, both themes (8.4:1).

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold words on navy only: the GluMira word, active tab underline, card ids.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: The label on a gold button (8.0:1 on the bottom of the band).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, 2px offset (dark 6.5:1 on navy; light 14.3:1 on bone).

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: navy-950 at an alpha: the only colour a shadow may use. Never black.

styles.name: b-heading
styles.usage: Pane titles, card titles, sub-headings. Colour: heading.

styles.name: b-body
styles.sample: Describe the production builder for ai studio
styles.usage: THE one body size: text, buttons, tabs, fields, chat.

styles.name: b-meta
styles.usage: Times, ids and the eyebrow only. Colour: muted.

styles.name: b-eyebrow
styles.usage: The one place for capitals (D-01): a small section label, set in capitals by the .gm-eyebrow class. Colour: muted.

styles.name: w-h1
styles.sample: The science of insulin, made visible

styles.name: w-body
styles.sample: See what your insulin is doing, hour by hour.
styles.usage: THE one body size on the websites.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between icon hit areas; the baseline unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a component; first content line below the pane head.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between list rows and cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane padding (the gutter) and between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Website: inside a section band.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Website only: between section bands.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Website only: page top and bottom.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Structure: header bars, pane edges, dividers, image placeholders.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Controls: button, field, select, chip, tab marker, table row.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Containers: card, menu, toast, open card.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Named exception: only things that are physically round (toggle, slider thumb, status dot). Never a button.

shadow.note: Light comes from the top right, so every shadow falls down and to the left. Mixed from navy-950, never black, never lighter than its owner.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: Cards and buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, the toast, a card opened next to its menu.

tokens.name: shadow-inner
tokens.usage: A pressed button; a field you type in.

layout.note: The one grid (D-03). Builder values are CSS px before the 125% zoom.

tokens.name: row-1
tokens.usage: Row 1: shield, title, small icons.

tokens.name: row-2
tokens.usage: Row 2: tabs, status, chat controls; its cells sit on the pane columns.

tokens.name: pane-head
tokens.usage: Every pane starts with it, the chat pane too, so the first lines meet.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Pane padding left and right; row 2 cell padding.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Every button and field in the Builder.

tokens.name: control-h-web
tokens.usage: Every button and field on the websites.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: The one icon size (D-07).

tokens.name: hit
tokens.usage: The hit area of an icon button.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: The one line thickness.

tokens.name: light-angle
tokens.usage: Every surface gradient: lit at the top right.

tokens.name: zoom-builder
tokens.usage: The Builder renders at 125% by default.
